Embedding request via Google Vertex AI using the vertex_ai/ provider prefix and the text-embedding-005 model — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":\"Hello\",\"model\":\"vertex_ai/text-embedding-005\"}", EmbeddingRequest::class.java)
    val apiKey = requireNotNull(System.getenv("API_KEY")) { "API_KEY must be set" }
    val result = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey = apiKey).use { client -> client.embed(req) }
    println(result.data)
    println(result.data.first().embedding)
}
```
